title.en: Together AI API Key - Open Source Model Cloud | Get Model Key
title.zh: Together AI API Key - 开源模型云平台 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Together AI API key for open-source model cloud. Run Llama, Mixtral and other models with competitive pricing.
description.zh: 获取 Together AI API Key，访问开源模型云平台。以有竞争力的价格运行 Llama、Mixtral 等模型。

en: Together AI is a cloud platform for running and serving open-source models—chat, code, rerank, and more—via a unified developer API.
It fits teams that want hosted open-source inference without managing their own GPU clusters, with OpenAI-style integration patterns in many cases.
getModelKey only links Together’s official API keys settings. We do not sell or host Together keys.
zh: Together AI 是托管运行开源模型的云平台，可通过统一开发者 API 调用对话、代码、重排序等能力。
适合希望使用托管开源推理、又不愿自建 GPU 集群的团队；许多接入方式接近 OpenAI 风格。
getModelKey 仅链接 Together 官方 API Keys 设置页，不出售、不托管 Together 密钥。

en: Visit api.together.xyz/settings/api-keys (or the Together console API keys section) and sign in.
Create a new API key, copy it once, and save it in a password manager or secrets store.
Send requests to Together’s documented API base URL using the key for authentication.
Rotate keys periodically and keep them out of frontend code and public repositories.
zh: 打开 api.together.xyz/settings/api-keys（或控制台 API Keys 区域）并登录。
创建新的 API Key，复制一次后保存到密码管理器或密钥库。
按官方文档的 API 地址发起请求，并使用该 Key 完成鉴权。
定期轮换密钥，勿放入前端代码或公开仓库。

question.en: Is Together AI the same as downloading open-source weights locally?
question.zh: Together AI 等于本地下载开源权重吗？

answer.en: No. Together hosts models in the cloud. You call their API; local self-hosting is a separate path via open weights elsewhere.
answer.zh: 不是。Together 在云端托管模型，你调用其 API；本地自托管需另寻开源权重部署。

question.en: Does getModelKey sell Together API keys?
question.zh: getModelKey 出售 Together API Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only link the official keys page. Create keys directly in Together’s console.
answer.zh: 不出售。我们只链接官方密钥页，请在 Together 控制台自行创建。

question.en: How do I verify model list and pricing?
question.zh: 如何确认模型列表与价格？

answer.en: Use Together’s official website and docs. Catalog and billing change over time; we do not invent prices.
answer.zh: 请查阅 Together 官网与文档。目录与计费会变化，本站不编造价格。
